# Golden vectors

Copied byte-for-byte from the relay design phase (a working directory `design/golden/`, generated by a
generator script on 2026-10-10; the design package itself is not part of this repository). They are the
cross-language contract between the on-chain relay and this SDK:

| file                           | what                                                                   |
| ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `init_policy_ix_data.hex`      | relay `init_policy` instruction data (802 bytes, flags = 2)            |
| `transfer_ix_data.hex`         | relay `transfer` data (amount 3,000,000)                               |
| `swap_ix_data.hex`             | relay `swap` data (amount_in 5,000,000, min_out 0, deadline 123456789) |
| `verify_ix_data.hex`           | core `verify` data for the transfer case (49 bytes)                    |
| `policy_example.bin` / `.json` | a 944-byte `RelayPolicy` account and its description                   |

Do not edit these files. If the program ABI changes, regenerate them from the design tool.

## Core mandate goldens

`golden_mandate.bin` (version 0, pre-hardening layout) and `golden_mandate_v1.bin` (version 1, stored
bump) are copied from the repository root `fixtures/`, where the Rust test `tests/layout_v1.rs` pins
them against the real core program. The SDK decodes them in `test/mandate-golden.test.ts`.
